title: 2026 Tacloban school shooting — Meaning, Genes, And Nothing Else #Shorts
description:
The selfish-gene reading of 2026 Tacloban school shooting makes it less romantic and far more precise. On June 22, 2026, at approximately 9:13 a.m. (PHT), a school shooting occurred at San Jose National High School in Tacloban, Philippines. Two suspects, aged 14 and 15, were arrested in connection with the shooting; one was apprehended at the scene, while the other was captured following a manhunt.

Behind 2026 Tacloban school shooting sits an animal brain negotiating with a story it tells itself. Classes at San Jose National High School as well as two nearby schools were suspended following the shooting, which was followed by another directive that suspended classes in all public elementary and secondary schools in Tacloban. Six schools in Tacloban and Palo, Leyte, and other schools in Calbayog, Borongan, and Naval, announced strengthened coordination with local police units and tighter security measures.
